high_level_description: The image is split into two distinct sections, each depicting different aspects of fashion. On the left side of the image, there is a scene from a fashion show. A model is walking down the runway, showcasing a beige, wide-legged pant with a high waist. The model's outfit is simple yet elegant, featuring a white top that is partially visible at the top of the frame. The audience is seated on either side of the runway, attentively watching the model. Many attendees are holding up their phones to capture the moment, indicating that this is a live event being documented.
